primary_user_question: עד כמה אפשר לסמוך על זה?
ux.default_experience: answer-first; technical provenance progressively disclosed; original source opens directly where lawful
ux.answer_model: proposition-grounded multi-source synthesis with high relevance threshold and numbered claim-level citations
ux.regular_mode: concise answer-first synthesis plus numbered evidence list
ux.researcher_mode: extended evidence analysis with subclaims, witness provenance, verification scope, context completeness, source-type/period/audience distinctions, Evidence Families, tensions and unanswered aspects
ux.language_policy: cross-language retrieval across Hebrew, Yiddish, English and any additional direct/authorized source languages; translations are derived, not independent witnesses
ux.precision_policy: precision over recall; lexical-only matches rejected; insufficient evidence is an acceptable result

verification_surge.effort_target: 75-85% promotion/verification until backlog is materially reduced; 15-25% breadth expansion
verification_surge.homogeneous_batch_target: 20-50 records when direct authorized item witnesses are stable and rights permit
blocking_reasons: metadata ambiguity or unresolved identity/dedup conflict

development_recovery.last_run_note: Batch 068 reviewed nine public source bodies: five Chabad-Lubavitch Library Hebrew item pages through search-visible body excerpts and four Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org English translation pages with line-addressable bodies. Added nine new letter identities and 18 non-verbatim source-grounded propositions. One Hebrew item is a free translation from Russian and four English items are translations from Hebrew; all five are marked non-independent and assigned one Evidence Family per underlying letter, so any future original-language witness must join that family. The five Library page opens returned zero readable lines; claims are limited to visible indexed excerpts. AID 4666220 redirected to a rewritten Torah Texts shell and was excluded; Yiddish discovery found no item-level transcript. No crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text copying. Dedup checked exact AIDs/URLs and letter numbers against current item paths, queue, bulk-indexed files and batches 061–067; a substring match for תשפה was rejected as a false duplicate because the existing item is יִתְשפה in volume 28, not תשפה in volume 4. The retrieval regression was traced to the generic 'הפצת המעיינות' alias in 'הרחבת שיעור חסידות'; the broad alias was removed and the synagogue-topic regression test strengthened. Before reconciliation: 698 answer-eligible families, 695 content-verified families, 2404 propositions; expected after: 707, 704, 2422. Reconciliation, quality gate and publication are pending.
